record.description: This shared obligation covers known-record reads, search, Discussion reads and lists, and dual-audience rendering. Search and Discussion lists provide paged retrieval. Discussion reads provide a way to fetch further messages. Other bounded views report continuation where supported or explicit truncation. Existing operations supply actual limits, cursor forms, and domain meanings.
